name: chart-line-04
title: Subscriber growth · TanStack Charts
description: Compare this year with last year. Built with TanStack Charts.

meta.prompt: Create a responsive subscriber growth card with a subtle border, rounded corners, and theme-aware colors. Show a small TanStack Charts label, a Subscriber growth heading, a comparison subtitle, and a prominent 368 subscribers metric. Include accessible 6 months and 3 months buttons with pressed states, initially showing January through June; the shorter window shows April through June. Plot two lines with point markers for this year and last year using distinct chart colors, a shared zero-based numeric axis, monthly labels, horizontal grid lines, and a visible labeled legend. Provide pointer and keyboard tooltips. Finish with a muted footer explaining the window controls.
